decisions.reason: Because this collector-oriented vinyl line fits the firm’s existing catalog and customer base, and there is no clear sign of results falling below aspiration levels, management would likely use available slack to continue it while learning from another year of market feedback.

Because a German new wave compilation series is very close to the firm’s established curated physical-media offer and the industry context is not adverse, management would likely retain it absent evidence of clear underperformance versus aspirations.
